result.brief: 提出表征强制（RepForcing），用冻结视频扩散Transformer的归一化特征做表征空间监督，替代中间教师轨迹回归，实现少步自回归视频蒸馏初始化。
result.reason: Uses frozen video diffusion transformer features for representation-space supervision in few-step autoregressive video distillation, directly serving video generation efficiency and representation.
